Home.heroSubtitle: Travel with rhythm, substance and discretion. Carefully designed journeys for six to eight guests, connecting selected regions across Europe by private jet, personally hosted from beginning to end.
Home.introTitle: A personal way to experience Europe
Home.introBody: ABATON JetJourneys is a founder-led boutique travel company based in Germany. We create only a small number of journeys each year, each bringing together carefully selected regions, hotels with character, local cuisine and experiences that offer a genuine connection to the destination. Private aviation allows the journey to follow a natural route between places that are often difficult to combine comfortably, and with only six to eight guests, the experience remains personal throughout.
Home.pillar1Body: Carefully planned private flights connect the different regions of each journey.
Home.pillar2Body: We give preference to exceptional independent and owner-led hotels with a genuine connection to their destination.
Home.pillar3Body: Local traditions, people and food form an important part of understanding every place we visit.
Home.pillar4Body: Every journey is accompanied by ABATON founder and private pilot Isabell Buchner.
Home.collectionBody: Discover the full ABATON Collection, including selected future journeys available through our Private Interest List.
Home.founderBody1: ABATON was founded by Isabell Buchner, a private pilot with a long-standing connection to European hospitality.
Home.founderBody2: She develops the journeys personally and accompanies every departure, remaining the familiar point of contact throughout the trip.
Home.closingBody: Explore our current collection or speak with us personally about an upcoming journey.

Experience.title: Travel with rhythm, substance and discretion.
Experience.lead: Private jet journeys through Europe for a small circle of six to eight guests. ABATON brings together private aviation, carefully selected hotels, regional cuisine, cultural encounters and personal hosting in one considered journey.
Experience.introBody1: ABATON JetJourneys is a founder-led boutique travel company. Our routes connect carefully selected regions across Europe that are often difficult to combine comfortably through commercial travel. Private aviation allows these places to become part of one considered journey, with less time spent in transit and more time at the destination.
Experience.introBody2: We stay in carefully selected hotels with character, giving preference to independent and owner-led properties with a genuine connection to their region. Restaurants, local hosts and experiences are chosen with the same care, with a focus on authenticity, quality and a sense of place.
Experience.introBody3: Each journey combines culture, landscape and gastronomy with enough time to enjoy the surroundings and the company of the group.
Experience.rhythmTitle: A day in the ABATON rhythm
Experience.rhythm1Body: A calm start to the day in a carefully selected hotel.
Experience.rhythm2Body: A chauffeur takes you to the private terminal before a short flight connects the next region.
Experience.rhythm3Body: Culture, landscape, food or local traditions offer a closer understanding of the destination.
Experience.rhythm4Body: Check into the next hotel with time to enjoy the property and its surroundings.
Experience.rhythm5Body: The day ends around the table with cuisine chosen for its quality and connection to the region.
Experience.standard1Body: Private aviation allows us to connect selected regions across Europe efficiently and comfortably. Aircraft are chosen according to the route, group size and operational requirements of each journey and are operated by licensed aviation partners.
Experience.standard2Body: Every journey is limited to six to eight guests and personally accompanied by ABATON founder and private pilot Isabell Buchner. The small group allows for personal attention and selected experiences that can be adapted to the interests of the guests.
Experience.standard3Body: Hotels are selected for their hospitality, location, character and connection to the destination. We give preference to exceptional independent and family owned properties, historic houses and individual retreats where the people and history behind the hotel contribute to the stay.
Experience.standard4Body: Cuisine is part of experiencing a region. Our journeys include carefully chosen restaurants, local producers, wine estates and culinary experiences that reflect the places we visit.
Experience.standard5Title: Experiences with a sense of place
Experience.standard5Body: Each journey includes experiences closely connected to its destinations. Private cultural visits, local traditions, landscapes, vineyards, estates and time on the water create a deeper understanding of the places along the route.
Experience.standard6Body: ABATON JetJourneys GmbH is a German tour operator. Journeys are organised in accordance with German package travel law and include the applicable statutory travel security. Flights are operated by licensed aviation partners and all journey partners are selected according to the requirements of each itinerary.

Experience.circleBody1: After a confirmed booking, guests receive access to the private ABATON Circle. The guest area brings together the information and personal details connected with the journey.
Experience.circleBody2: Connect with fellow guests travelling on the same journey and exchange recommendations within the ABATON community. Access to the ABATON Circle is complimentary and reserved for confirmed guests.

GoodToKnow.title: Good to know
GoodToKnow.intro: The practical detail behind every ABATON journey, from booking and baggage to payment, protection and cancellation. For questions specific to a journey, see its own page.
GoodToKnow.bookTitle: How do I book a journey?
GoodToKnow.bookBody: Every ABATON journey begins with a personal inquiry. Once you get in touch, you will receive detailed information together with a booking form. A 30% deposit is due at the time of booking. Your journey becomes binding once the minimum number of participants is reached, or at the latest 90 days before departure. We recommend waiting for your official booking confirmation before making any further travel arrangements.
GoodToKnow.includedTitle: What is included in the price?
included: All private jet flights, departure and return at the designated base airport
Daily breakfast, selected lunches or a packed lunch, and dinners
All curated experiences and excursions as outlined in the itinerary
A personal journey host and full travel coordination throughout
Taxes, handling fees and service charges
GoodToKnow.includedNot: Not included: personal expenses, optional excursions beyond the programme, visa fees, and travel insurance.
GoodToKnow.suitableTitle: Who are ABATON journeys suitable for?
GoodToKnow.suitableBody: Our journeys are designed for discerning travellers who value unique, comfortable and beautifully curated experiences. Due to the nature of private aviation and some of the activities involved, they are not suitable for guests with severe claustrophobia or a strong susceptibility to motion sickness.
GoodToKnow.healthBody: Please let us know about any medical conditions, allergies or mobility restrictions before booking. Due to the nature of some destinations and activities, our journeys may not be fully accessible to all guests. If you have mobility challenges, or are affected by claustrophobia or motion sickness, please speak to us in advance so we can advise whether a journey is right for you.
baggage: One personal item or small carry-on, max. 5 kg
GoodToKnow.baggageBody: Because of space constraints and the multi-stop nature of our journeys, we ask all guests to pack efficiently. Additional luggage must be requested in advance and may incur an extra charge.
GoodToKnow.safetyBody: We work exclusively with certified private jet operators and experienced flight crews. All aircraft meet the highest industry safety and maintenance standards.
GoodToKnow.minBody: If the minimum number of participants for a journey is not reached, ABATON reserves the right to cancel it. All payments already made will be refunded in full. You will receive your final booking confirmation once the journey is secured, at the latest 90 days before departure.
GoodToKnow.paymentBody: A 30% deposit is due within 7 days of your booking confirmation. The balance is due no later than 60 days before departure. Payment can be made by bank transfer, credit card, or another accepted payment method. Fees arising from international transfers are payable by the traveller.
GoodToKnow.protectionBody: ABATON JetJourneys GmbH is a registered and licensed tour operator based in Germany and meets all legal requirements for European tour operators, including statutory insolvency protection under the EU Package Travel Directive. With every booking, you receive a Sicherungsschein (travel security certificate) as legally required, so your payments are protected.
GoodToKnow.insuranceBody: We strongly recommend comprehensive travel cancellation and interruption insurance, as well as international health cover including repatriation. Travel insurance is not included in the journey price.
GoodToKnow.visaBody: Every traveller is responsible for ensuring their passport, visa and entry documents meet the requirements of all countries visited. We are glad to advise on what is required, but we cannot handle visa applications on your behalf.
GoodToKnow.cancelIntro: If you need to cancel, the following fees apply:
cancel: Up to 120 days before departure: 30% of the journey price
119 to 90 days before departure: 35% of the journey price
89 to 60 days before departure: 55% of the journey price
59 to 30 days before departure: 80% of the journey price
From 29 days before departure, or in case of no-show: 100% of the journey price
GoodToKnow.cancelBody: Cancellations must be submitted in writing. You are welcome to provide evidence of a lower loss, in which case a reduced fee may apply. Full details are set out in our Terms & Conditions.
GoodToKnow.portalBody: Once you have booked, you receive access to the ABATON Circle, a secure space to manage your documents, connect with fellow travellers, and preview upcoming experiences.

JourneyDetail.backToJourneysTitle: Back to all ABATON private jet journeys
JourneyDetail.staysIntro: The journey moves from city refinement to Irish lakes, castle grandeur, Highland seclusion and Edinburgh heritage.
JourneyDetail.hostTitle: Personally hosted, from the first welcome to the final flight
JourneyDetail.hostBody1: ABATON was founded by Isabell Buchner, a private pilot with a long-standing connection to European hospitality. Her belief is simple: the most memorable journeys are not defined by how many places are visited, but by how naturally they are connected and how personally they are experienced.
JourneyDetail.hostBody2: Isabell accompanies every ABATON Jet Journey herself. She is the familiar face throughout the trip, welcoming the group, coordinating the journey with the local partners and ensuring that a group of only a few guests never feels like a conventional tour.
JourneyDetail.hostCtaTitle: Arrange a personal conversation with ABATON founder Isabell Buchner
JourneyDetail.circleTitle: After booking: welcome to the ABATON Circle
JourneyDetail.circleBody: Once your journey is confirmed, your private ABATON guest area becomes the central place for everything connected with your trip. Review your evolving itinerary, manage travel preferences, select eligible activities, submit dietary requirements, access invoices and confirmations, and send concierge requests before departure.
JourneyDetail.difference1Body: A deliberately small group creates space for personal service, flexible experiences and a more natural way of travelling together.
JourneyDetail.difference2Body: Selected sectors are flown privately to reduce long overland journeys and awkward commercial connections.
JourneyDetail.difference3Body: Every journey is personally accompanied by ABATON founder and private pilot Isabell Buchner.
JourneyDetail.difference4Body: The itinerary is intentionally not built around constant sightseeing. Each destination includes time to slow down, explore and enjoy the hotel or landscape.
JourneyDetail.difference5Body: ABATON favours distinctive hotels, historic properties and retreats that contribute to the story of the journey.
JourneyDetail.difference6Body: Before departure, booked guests can manage preferences, documents, selected activities and concierge requests through the private ABATON guest area.

About.title: A personal approach to travel
About.lead: ABATON JetJourneys was founded with the idea of creating a more personal way to experience Europe. Behind every journey is a personal selection of places, hotels, people and experiences that reflect the region itself.
About.founderBody1: ABATON was founded by Isabell Buchner. Her connection to travel combines two worlds that have accompanied her for many years: aviation and European hospitality.
About.founderBody2: As a private pilot, she has experienced first hand how aviation can change the way regions are connected. Through her family's long-standing business relationship with hotels across Europe, hospitality and the people behind exceptional hotels have also been part of her personal background.
About.founderBody3: These two perspectives became the foundation for ABATON JetJourneys. Isabell develops the journeys personally and accompanies every departure herself. She remains the familiar face throughout the journey and works closely with the aviation partners, hotels, chauffeurs and local hosts involved along the route.
About.ideaBody1: Only a small number of ABATON JetJourneys are created and released each year. Each is limited to six to eight guests. Routes are built around regions that complement one another and can be connected naturally through private aviation. Hotels, restaurants and experiences are selected individually for each destination.
About.ideaBody2: Particular attention is given to independent and owner-led hotels with character, local knowledge and genuine hospitality. The same approach applies to cuisine and experiences. The aim is always to understand something of the place itself and the people who shape it.
About.nameBody1: The name ABATON has its origins in ancient Greek and describes a place that is not freely accessible.
About.nameBody2: For us, it represents a more personal way of discovering Europe, through places, encounters and experiences shared within a small circle of guests.
About.hostedTitle: From the first welcome to the final flight
About.hostedBody1: Personal hosting is part of every ABATON journey. With only six to eight guests, there is time to know the people travelling, understand individual preferences and create a natural atmosphere within the group.
About.hostedBody2: Isabell accompanies the journey from beginning to end and remains available to guests throughout.
About.ctaBody: Discover the current ABATON Collection and the journeys available through our Private Interest List.
